question: What range and increment govern the measure from one to seven barley grains?
premises: The range extends from one to seven barley grains.
The increase proceeds by one measure.
inference: The measure increases by one unit from one up to seven barley grains.
uncertainties: The repetition of saptayavāntaṃ is preserved as in the transmitted text.
plain_english: Indeed, increasing by one measure from one up to seven barley grains.
